title: Letter to a landlord about a problem
prompt:
You are renting a flat and there has been a problem with the water supply for the past two weeks. You have already told the building manager, but nothing has been done.

Write a letter to your landlord. In your letter

- describe the problem with the water supply
- explain how it is affecting you
- say what you would like the landlord to do

Write at least 150 words.

You do NOT need to write any addresses at the top of your letter.

Begin your letter as follows:

Dear Mr Adeyemi,

title: Letter to a manager requesting time off
prompt:
You would like to take a short course which is related to your job. The course takes place on two weekday afternoons each week for three months.

Write a letter to your manager. In your letter

- describe the course
- explain how it would benefit your work
- suggest how your duties could be covered while you are away

Write at least 150 words.

title: Opinion: Free university education
prompt:
Some people believe that university education should be free for all students, paid for by the government.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Discuss both views: Working from home
prompt:
Some people think that working from home is better for employees and businesses. Others believe that people work more effectively when they are together in an office.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Advantages and disadvantages: Studying abroad
prompt:
Increasing numbers of young people choose to complete their higher education in a foreign country.

Do the advantages of this outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Problem and solution: Traffic congestion
prompt:
In many large cities, traffic congestion is becoming a serious problem.

What are the main causes of this problem, and what measures could be taken to solve it?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Two-part question: Online shopping
prompt:
Nowadays, many people buy most of their goods online rather than in local shops and markets.

Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.

title: Opinion: Children and household chores
prompt:
Some people say that children should be required to help with household tasks from a young age, while others think they should spend their free time on studying and play.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Write at least 250 words.
